title: NOTIFICATION FOR INTERVIEW FOR THE POST OF SENIOR PERSONAL ASSISTANT
text:
KEY LINES:
Hon'ble Court Judgment & Order Dated16.05.2025 in Writ

FULL TEXT:
UNACHAL PRADESH
LIC SERVICE COMMISSION
ITANAGAR
No.PSC-R-A/05/2020 Dated Itanagar, the 4th July, 2025
NOTIFICATION
In pursuance
of
Hon'ble Court Judgment & Order Dated16.05.2025 in Writ
Appeal Case No.WA/22/2024 filed APPSC & Anr.
-Vs-
Hibu Tapa & Anr. and in
continuation to result notification No. PSC-R-A/05/2020 Dated 9
th
September, 2022, the
viva-voce/interview for the post
of
Senior Personal Assistant will be held on 18th July,
2025 (Friday) from
11
:00 A.M. onwards at APPSC office, Itanagar.
Candidates are informed to collect their call letter from the reception counter,
APPSC office on any working day w.e.f 9th July 2025 to
15
th
July 2025 from
11
:00 AM
to 04:00 PM. Further, candidates are required to submit the self-attested copies
of
the
following documents at the reception counter, APPSC office, Itanagar before
11
th July,
2025. 1.
Class-X Certificate and Mark-sheet.
2. Class-XII Certificate and Mark-sheet.
3. Degree Certificate and Mark-sheet.
4. APST Certificate.
5. Intimation letter to HoD/NoC,
if
any.
Memo No.PSC-R-A/05/2020
Copy to: -
The PS to Chairman, APPSC, for information.
( Parul G r Mittal ) IRS
Secretary, APPSC
Dated Itanagar, the 4th July, 2025
/4 IT Cell, APPSC to upload the notification in the APPSC Website.3.
Office copy.
~( Parul aur Mittal) IRS
Secretary, APPSC
